name: Flight Of The Exorcist
source:
Flight of the Exorcist is a short visual novel about a crisis of faith in the face of suffering and a world where demons influence the fate of humanity.

Belief is nothing if it is not tested, this is something Charlotte found out the hard way as her life as an exorcist came crashing down. Now on the run and barely ahead of her former colleagues, she walks through the backwater places of the world searching for an answer to her questions. She wants to believe but all she had witnesses prevents her from truly letting go of her doubt. And now those nagging voices are about to come back to bite her.

One day Charlotte happens upon an unassuming village and decides to stay the night there. Little does she know that a demon possession is about to shake this quiet hamlet to its core. As the villagers start dropping like flies, Charlotte has to contend with people suspecting her as she is the outsider who wandered into their home. Now she must utilise her skills to investigate these deaths and find the culprit to clear her name.

But can she save these people from the touch of demons or will she lose her very soul?

[From [url=https://pallas-raven.itch.io/flight-of-the-exorcist]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《驱魔人的飞行》是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述了面对苦难的信仰危机以及恶魔影响人类命运的世界。

如果没有经过检验，信仰就毫无意义，这是夏洛特在她作为驱魔师的生活崩溃时经历的艰难发现的事情。现在，她在逃亡中，几乎领先于她以前的同事，她穿过世界上的穷乡僻壤，寻找她问题的答案。她想要相信，但所有的目击者都阻止她真正放下怀疑。而现在那些唠叨的声音又要回来咬她了。

有一天，夏洛特偶然发现了一个不起眼的村庄，并决定在那里过夜。她不知道恶魔附体即将彻底动摇这个安静的小村庄。当村民们开始像苍蝇一样倒下时，夏洛特必须应对那些怀疑她的人，因为她是闯入他们家的外人。现在她必须运用自己的技能调查这些死亡事件，找到罪魁祸首，还清自己的罪名。

但她能否将这些人从恶魔的手中拯救出来，还是会失去灵魂呢？

[来自[url=https://pallas-raven.itch.io/flight-of-the-exorcist]Itch.io[/url]]
